howToPlay: Use your morning stars to attack from new angles by recalling them after two throws. Time your Super to land the third explosion and trap enemies in place.
gears: Equip DAMAGE for increased output when low on health, or SHIELD to improve your survivability. GADGET COOLDOWN is also useful to trigger your fire or ice effects more frequently.
trait: Lumi is a damage dealer who excels at controlling space and punishing enemies through calculated positioning.
